summary: Shows hashing prompted values with encrypt (e.g. sha512_crypt), confirm and salt_size; lists passlib schemes and the four crypt fallbacks (bcrypt, md5_crypt, sha256_crypt, sha512_crypt) when passlib isn't installed.
questions: How do I hash a prompted password for the user module?
How do I make vars_prompt ask for confirmation?
Which hash schemes does vars_prompt support without passlib?

answer_card.title: Hashing prompted values
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
vars_prompt:
  - name: my_password2
    prompt: Enter password2
    private: true
    encrypt: sha512_crypt
    confirm: true
    salt_size: 7
```

Only `salt` or `salt_size` are accepted (default salt size 8). With **passlib**, many schemes work (bcrypt, sha256_crypt, md5_crypt, pbkdf2_digest, ...). Without it, the crypt fallback supports at most `bcrypt`, `md5_crypt`, `sha256_crypt`, `sha512_crypt`.
